subproblem.title: Rescaled boxes Z(s, s') are squeezed between two squares
subproblem.statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with orthogonal projection π := Q.starProjection, and a, e ∈ ℝ^P with a ∈ Q, |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0. Let s, η, s' ∈ ℝ with 0 < η, 0 < s', 20s' < 1, 30s' < η and 6s' < s. Put η_{s'} := dilation a s' (η_{s'}(x) = s'^{-1}(x − a)), Z(s, s') := {x : ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩)| < s', |x − πx| < s|x|}, U := {w : |w| < 3, |⟨w, a⟩| < 1 − η, |⟨w, e⟩| < 1 − η} and K := {w : |w| ≤ 3, |⟨w, a⟩| ≤ 1 + η, |⟨w, e⟩| ≤ 1 + η}. Then η_{s'}^{-1}(U) ⊆ Z(s, s') and Z(s, s') ∩ B_{3s'}(a) ⊆ η_{s'}^{-1}(K).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (s η s' : ℝ), a ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < η → 0 < s' → 20 * s' < 1 → 30 * s' < η → 6 * s' < s → dilation a s' ⁻¹' {w : Euclid P | ‖w‖ < 3 ∧ |inner ℝ w a| < 1 - η ∧ |inner ℝ w e| < 1 - η} ⊆ {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s' ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∧ {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s' ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∩ ball a (3 * s') ⊆ dilation a s' ⁻¹' {w : Euclid P | ‖w‖ ≤ 3 ∧ |inner ℝ w a| ≤ 1 + η ∧ |inner ℝ w e| ≤ 1 + η}
subproblem.natural_proof:
Notation: f(x) := arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩) (real division). By definition dilation a s' x = −(s'^{-1}•a) + s'^{-1}•x, so η_{s'}(x) = s'^{-1}(x − a) and x = a + s'·η_{s'}(x). Note 0 < s' < 1/20 and s > 6s' > 0.
1. (Estimates.) Let w ∈ ℝ^P with |w| < 3 and put x := a + s'w, p := s'⟨w, a⟩, q := s'⟨w, e⟩.
(a) By Cauchy–Schwarz and |a| = |e| = 1: |p| ≤ s'|w| < 3s' and |q| < 3s'.
(b) ⟨x, a⟩ = |a|² + p = 1 + p > 1 − 3s' > 17/20 > 0, and ⟨x, e⟩ = ⟨a, e⟩ + q = q.
(c) |x| ≥ ⟨x, a⟩ > 17/20 (Cauchy–Schwarz with |a| = 1).
(d) |x|² = |a|² + 2s'⟨a, w⟩ + s'²|w|² = 1 + y with y := 2p + s'²|w|², and |y| < 6s' + 9s'² < 7s' (as 9s'² < s'). Let t := |x| ≥ 0, so t² = 1 + y. From (t − 1)(t + 1) = y and t + 1 ≥ 1 we get |t − 1| ≤ |y|; and t − 1 − y/2 = t − 1 − (t² − 1)/2 = −(t − 1)²/2, so |t − 1 − y/2| ≤ y²/2 < 49s'²/2. Also 0 ≤ y/2 − p = s'²|w|²/2 < 9s'²/2. Hence ||x| − 1 − p| < 29s'² ≤ 30s'².
(e) By (b), ⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩ = z := q/(1 + p), so f(x) = arctan z. Since 1 + p > 17/20: |z − q| = |q||p|/(1 + p) < 9s'²·20/17 < 11s'², and |z| < 3s'·20/17 < 4s'. By the mean value theorem (arctan' = 1/(1 + ξ²)) there is ξ between 0 and z with arctan z − z = (1/(1 + ξ²) − 1)z = −ξ²z/(1 + ξ²), so |arctan z − z| ≤ ξ²|z| ≤ |z|³ < 64s'³ < 4s'² (as s' < 1/20). Hence |f(x) − q| < 15s'² ≤ 30s'².
(f) Since a ∈ Q, πa = a; π is linear, so x − πx = s'(w − πw). By Pythagoras (|w|² = |πw|² + |w − πw|²), |w − πw| ≤ |w| < 3, hence |x − πx| < 3s'.
2. (η_{s'}^{-1}(U) ⊆ Z(s, s').) Let x ∈ η_{s'}^{-1}(U) and w := η_{s'}(x); then |w| < 3, |⟨w, a⟩| < 1 − η, |⟨w, e⟩| < 1 − η and x = a + s'w. With p, q as in step 1, |p| < s'(1 − η) and |q| < s'(1 − η). By 1(b), ⟨x, a⟩ > 0. By 1(d), ||x| − 1| ≤ |p| + 30s'² < s'(1 − η) + 30s'² = s' − s'(η − 30s') < s', using 30s' < η. By 1(e), |f(x)| ≤ |q| + 30s'² < s' in the same way. By 1(f), 1(c) and 6s' < s: |x − πx| < 3s' < s/2 < (17/20)s < s|x|. Thus x ∈ Z(s, s').
3. (Z(s, s') ∩ B_{3s'}(a) ⊆ η_{s'}^{-1}(K).) Let x ∈ Z(s, s') with |x − a| < 3s' and put w := η_{s'}(x). Then x = a + s'w and |w| = |x − a|/s' < 3; in particular |w| ≤ 3 and step 1 applies. By 1(d) and ||x| − 1| < s': s'|⟨w, a⟩| = |p| ≤ ||x| − 1| + ||x| − 1 − p| < s' + 30s'², hence |⟨w, a⟩| < 1 + 30s' < 1 + η. By 1(e) and |f(x)| < s': s'|⟨w, e⟩| = |q| ≤ |f(x)| + |f(x) − q| < s' + 30s'², hence |⟨w, e⟩| < 1 + η. Thus η_{s'}(x) ∈ K, i.e. x ∈ η_{s'}^{-1}(K). ∎
proof_key_steps: Write x = a + s'w with w = η_{s'}(x) = s'^{-1}(x − a).
For |w| < 3 and s' < 1/20: ⟨x, a⟩ > 17/20, |x| > 17/20, ||x| − 1 − s'⟨w, a⟩| ≤ 30s'² (square-root expansion), |f(x) − s'⟨w, e⟩| ≤ 30s'² (|arctan z − z| ≤ |z|³) and |x − πx| < 3s'.
If w ∈ U, every defining inequality of Z(s, s') holds because 30s' < η and 6s' < s.

audit.reason: The hypotheses match exactly. The norm and arctangent error bounds are valid with constant 30; projection contraction and 6s' < s give the transverse bound. Both inclusions follow. Neither e ∈ Q nor an upper bound on η is needed.
